channel.title: The Art Newspaper - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Art Newspaper (theartnewspaper.com)

item.title: Miami’s ancient Indigenous sites face an uncertain future
item.description: The city’s building boom has revealed many artefacts and human remains, but the pace of development has made study and preservation challenging

item.title: Manumission digitisation project reveals grim story of slavery in Brazil
item.description: Records show how masters retained power over enslaved people even after emancipation

item.title: Can you feel the love tonight? Elton John's cosy family portrait captured by Catherine Opie
item.description: Picture featuring his sons, husband David and their dogs goes on show at the National Portrait Gallery in London

item.title: A brush with… Danh Vo—podcast
item.description: Danh Vo talks to Ben Luke about her influences—from writers to musicians, film-makers and, of course, other artists—and the cultural experiences that have shaped her life and work

item.title: ‘He always had spirituality’: Spanish exhibition unpicks Picasso's religious influences
item.description: The exhibition, held in Burgos's Gothic cathedral, brings together 44 works spanning six decades of the artist's career

item.title: Obscured Gauguin nude sculpture may be revealed in its entirety following museum donation
item.description: Overpainting of the genitals of a figure in the relief panel “Te Fare Amu”—once described as a “serious editorial suppression of Gauguin’s original concept”—is expected to be removed at the Brooklyn Museum

item.title: Former Louvre president Pierre Rosenberg on his new Poussin catalogue—and forthcoming museum
item.description: The art historian is cementing his legacy in the form of a catalogue raisonné and a home for his vast collection

item.title: A new home for Asian contemporary art opens in landmarked building in Manhattan's Chinatown
item.description: Founded by Alexander Wang and his mother Ying, the Wang Contemporary debuted at the landmarked 58 Bowery with a MSCHF installation timed to Lunar New Year

item.title: Liliana Angulo Cortés, director of Bogotá’s Museo Nacional de Colombia, has died, aged 51
item.description: Angulo’s work was devoted to decolonising the museum, anti-racism and reparation with a special focus on diversifying narratives to include more Black and Indigenous voices

item.title: ‘There’s a bead connection to every place’: Wendy Red Star on exploring the real and symbolic currency of beads
item.description: The Apsáalooke artist’s new exhibition at Sargent’s Daughters in New York takes the form of a simulated trading floor for glass beads
